summary.text: Jack David Woodrum is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 10, listed with Summers County; the district covers Summers, Monroe, Greenbrier and Nicholas counties and part of Fayette. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Enrolled Bills Committee.

paragraphs.text: Woodrum's page lists his education as the Cincinnati College of Mortuary Science, the Tyree School of Real Estate, and several leadership programs through NACo and West Virginia University, and his occupation as funeral director, embalmer and restorative artist.
It gives his birthplace as Hinton, West Virginia, names his spouse as Debra A. “Debbie” (Brookman) Woodrum, and lists three children and one granddaughter.
His affiliations include the National Funeral Directors Association, the West Virginia Funeral Directors Association, the National Rifle Association (life member) and Lions International.

In addition to chairing Enrolled Bills, Woodrum is vice chair of the Government Organization and Workforce committees and also serves on the Economic Development, Finance and Natural Resources committees.
